decisions.title: Package manager and module standards
decisions.decision: Use pnpm as package manager; TypeScript ESM only ('type': 'module') across Node runtime and scripts.

decisions.title: Repo and domain target
decisions.decision: Remote repo set to https://github.com/Catalyst-Forge-LLC/efficacy.git with efficacy.dev as public domain target.

decisions.title: Spec authority
decisions.decision: docs/efficacy-spec-v0.3.md is the active specification for the project. Haulout doc ignored for initial kickoff.

decisions.title: Monorepo layout
decisions.decision: pnpm workspace with packages/core, packages/cli, and site/.
decisions.rationale: User confirmed monorepo. Core stays usable without the CLI; the spec site stays separate from the crypto package.

decisions.title: v1 hero flow
decisions.decision: efficacy init writes a genesis JSONL line, efficacy record appends a use line, efficacy verify walks the chain and reports the first failed check or a trust tier.
decisions.rationale: User confirmed this as the v1 hero flow.

decisions.title: Do not invent spec-open answers
decisions.decision: v1 will not define a key registry, a shared public-key directory, cross-repo bridging, or per-kind evidence schemas.
decisions.rationale: efficacy-spec-v0.3 leaves those unresolved and says implementations must not invent them.

decisions.title: Spec site and hosting
decisions.decision: site/ is a FilePress static site. efficacy.dev is registered at Cloudflare. DNS and production hosting are Cloudflare, with Pages for the site. No application database. No desktop GUI.
decisions.rationale: User confirmed the stack and that the domain is already on Cloudflare.

decisions.title: Local port for the spec site
decisions.decision: LocalSlip claims the FilePress dev port. Do not pass a hardcoded port and do not add a package only to read the lease.
decisions.rationale: User accepted LocalSlip for the site. ColdEye and xFacts stay deferred.

decisions.title: Published npm package name
decisions.decision: The public package name is efficacy. packages/core stays private to the workspace.
decisions.rationale: The user staked the npm name efficacy. One public package is enough for v1.

decisions.title: Implementation license
decisions.decision: The code is Apache-2.0. The spec stays CC0.
decisions.rationale: User accepted Apache-2.0 so adopters receive a contributor patent grant.
